basic.author: Stephen Mayhew and Chase Duncan and Mark Sammons and Chen-Tse Tsai and Dan Roth and Xin Li and Haojie Pan and Sheng Zhou and Jennifer Zou and Yangqiu Song
basic.title: University of Illinois LoReHLT17 Submission
basic.abstract:
The UIUC team participated in two tasks in the LoReHLT17 evaluation: Entity Discovery and Linking (EDL) and Situation Frames (SF). In this document, we describe the approaches and results for each task.
The two surprise languages were Tigrinya (IL5) and Oromo (IL6). Both language are spoken in the Horn of Africa region around Ethiopia and Eritrea. IL5 and IL6 are similar to Amharic and Somali respectively.
